title: LightingQuality
description: Which renderer shades the scene. The scene never names one: it describes what emits and what blocks, and the system reports which renderer turned that into pixels. `forward` shades inside the sprite shader against a capacity-bounded light texture: one draw, no extra targets, no shadows. It is the floor, and for now the only one.
